title: Saites
summary: Saites is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 118; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 59 to 75, and Eusebius, Chronicle 15 to 17
reign.note: First of six Hyksos kings in the fifteenth dynasty. A footnote says this is the seventeenth dynasty according to Eusebius. The dynasty number is left as the edition prints it.

reign.date: “Salatis died after a reign of nineteen years”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 127; Manetho, ap. Josephus, Against Apion, book 1
reign.note: Josephus's extract. The dynasty list (p. 118) prints 19 years for Saites [or, Salatis].
